summary: Comprehensive testing of client confirmation flow (DRIVER_COMPLETED → DONE). All 11 backend tests passed. Frontend ConfirmRidePage tested on mobile viewport (390x844). Invalid token error handling fixed. DriverRidePage timeline verified with correct timestamps.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/driver/confirm-ride/{ride_id}?token - returns ride details with driver info for confirmation page
POST /api/driver/confirm-ride/{ride_id}?token - changes status DRIVER_COMPLETED → DONE and invalidates both tokens
Token validation working correctly - 403 for invalid token, 404 for non-existent ride
Double-confirmation protection - tokens invalidated after first confirmation, subsequent attempts return 403
Both driver_access_token and client_confirmation_token are set to null after confirmation
ConfirmRidePage displays all required info: client greeting, ride details, timeline, addresses, price, driver info
ConfirmRidePage success state shows 'Course confirmée!' with checkmark and thank you message
DriverRidePage timeline correctly shows Attribuée/Démarrée/Terminée with timestamps
Mobile-first design well implemented with proper max-w-lg container and responsive layout
